title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Dispersion — 2020
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Differentiate between deviation of light and dispersion of light.
questions.solution:
**Deviation of light:** The bending of a single ray (or single colour) of light from its original straight path when it passes through a prism or a slab, by an angle $\delta$.
$$\delta = i + e - A$$
It occurs even for **monochromatic** light.

**Dispersion of light:** The splitting of white light into its constituent colours because different colours are deviated by different angles. It requires **polychromatic** (white) light.

**Key differences:** Deviation is a change in direction of one ray; dispersion is a separation of colours, so $\text{dispersion} > \text{deviation}$ for white light. A red glass slab disperses (gives colour) but a plain glass slab of same shape only deviates.
questions.knowledgeNote: Deviation bends a single ray of light; dispersion splits white light into colours due to varying refractive index.
